title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Algeria-Austria World Cup Controversy: World Cup match between Algeria and Austria sparks outrage as Algeria appears to concede a late equalizer on purpose to avoid Spain in the Round of 16.
Harry Kane Reaches 70 Goals: Harry Kane reaches 70 goals for club and country this season, placing him second this century behind Lionel Messi's historic 82-goal year.
OpenCode v2 Shared Backend: OpenCode v2 introduces a unified backend for TUI, desktop, and web clients, significantly reducing resource footprint and enabling default state sync.
Claude Code Ad Monetization: Developers introduce 'Kickbacks', an ad marketplace built into the Claude Code terminal spinner, allowing engineers to monetize execution wait times.
Beijing China Zun Plane Crash Mystery: Financial commentators trace links between the June 26 Beijing China Zun CITIC Tower plane crash and failed stock margin calls of local bank executives.
Midea AC European Boom: Chinese manufacturer Midea's window AC units see massive demand and price hikes from €800 to €2000 in Europe due to escalating summer heatwaves.

items.title: Andrew McCalip (@andrewmccalip)
items.body: Andrew McCalip launches 'Kickbacks', a browser extension and ad marketplace for the Claude Code execution spinner, allowing developers to monetize terminal waiting time.

items.title: Dax (@thdxr)
items.body: Dax announces that OpenCode v2 shares a unified backend across TUI, desktop, and web instances, minimizing CPU/memory footprint and keeping all windows synchronized by default.
